current.text: Signed a four-year, 64 million USD contract with Milwaukee this offseason.
Experts call the contract horrific and say it is unclear where he fits on a roster full of guards.
Milwaukee's guard rotation is crowded. Rollins, Herro, Kevin Porter Jr., Jakucionis, Burries and Green all compete for backcourt minutes.
He is not in the projected opening starting lineup of Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
He played very poorly last season, but he may get minutes so the team can justify his contract.
New coach Taylor Jenkins' rotations are hard to predict, and he may use a deep rotation. That makes bench guard minutes uncertain.
Milwaukee is expected to focus more on developing young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes.
He is not a draft target in our 12-team league. Both sites price him at 0 USD and rank him well outside the 144 players who get drafted.

durable.text: His rebounds are very low, even for a guard, and rank among the weakest in the league.
